record.question: Who is the writer of a book, “Ignited Mind”?
record.explanation: The former President's book catalogue identifies Ignited Minds as A. P. J. Abdul Kalam's book. The printed title omits the final s; preserve that typo visibly. Historical exam context: 2018 (year only; no day/month printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.presidentofindia.gov.in/dr-apj-abdul-kalam/book/ignited-minds Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
